title: Provisioning and configuration management: two different jobs

videos.script: Ana needed a network for the shop, so she typed one. A VPC, a subnet, a firewall rule. It worked, and for an afternoon that was enough. {{typed}} A week later, a colleague opened SSH to the whole internet, by hand, from another machine. Nobody told her, and nothing could. {{drift}} Then somebody asked her to make sure the network was set up. She ran her script again, and AWS built a second network beside the first. {{twice}} This lesson is about the alternative. You describe what should exist, in a file, and a program makes the world match it. Run it twice and nothing happens the second time. {{declare}} There are two jobs hiding in that idea. Creating the resources a cloud sells, and configuring what runs inside a machine. They need different tools, and most trouble starts where the two overlap. {{layers}} By the end you will know which tool does which job, and you will have built the lab every later lesson runs on: an emulated AWS on your own computer, with no bill. {{lab}}
